description: ダムデータ [dams, reservoirs and flood defences] is a dataset listed in National Land Numerical Information (国土数値情報) download site of MLIT, Japan, an open data portal, published or maintained by 国土交通省. 本データは、全国のダムについて形式（アーチダム、重力式コンクリートダム、ロックフィルダム等）、目的（洪水調節・農地防災、灌漑用水、発電等）、総貯水量、有効貯水量、事業者、名称等の位置を整備したものです。. Coverage: Japan. The portal files it under the publisher 国土交通省. It offers 1 resource(s) in shp, geojson. The portal shows 2014-12-31 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is non-commercial use only under the download site terms. Caveats: this record was written from the product page on the download site (title, description where given, licence, formats and dates), so the data files were not opened, their contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-japan-mlit-national-land-numerical-information.
